race.title: Paul Ferguson's Jumpers To Follow Amateur Jockeys' Handicap Hurdle
race.verdict: CADILLAC RANCH is relatively unexposed for one at this level and has built up a good rapport with his amateur rider. He gets the nod over Market House , who looks to have solid claims under Alex Chadwick, with Prairie Diamond and Rip Wheeler also worth considering in a tricky betting heat. CADILLAC RANCH (IRE) MARKET HOUSE (IRE) PRAIRIE DIAMOND (IRE)
